THE PRINCESS TRANSFORMATION
MASTER AI VIDEO GENERATION PROMPT

FORMAT: Cinematic fairy-tale beauty transformation
DURATION: Approximately 36–45 seconds
STRUCTURE: 8 consecutive shots using 8 separate reference images
VISUAL STYLE: Photorealistic luxury fashion editorial, magical realism, royal fairy-tale fantasy
ASPECT RATIO: 9:16 for YouTube Shorts, Reels, and TikTok; 16:9 for widescreen YouTube
AUDIO: Enchanting orchestral fairy-tale music with synchronized environmental sound effects
1. MASTER VISUAL BIBLE
Create an ultra-luxurious, dreamy fairy-tale transformation film set inside a magnificent pink-and-gold rococo palace and its enchanted garden.
The interior features blush-pink velvet, cream-and-gold carved furniture, ornate gilded mirrors, crystal chandeliers, pink satin curtains, crystal perfume bottles, polished marble floors, pink roses, and delicate floating glitter particles.
The royal dressing chamber contains a towering cream-and-gold wardrobe with ornate carvings and a pink tufted velvet interior. Inside hangs a spectacular blush-pink ball gown embellished with crystals, sequins, floral appliqués, layered ruffles, and a voluminous skirt.
The exterior is a breathtaking sunlit palace garden with cascading pink roses, blue hydrangeas, lavender wisteria, flower-covered arches, white marble columns, turquoise reflecting pools, hanging crystals, and an elaborate floral swing.

Use a consistent palette of blush pink, rose pink, ivory, champagne gold, crystal white, soft lavender, and turquoise.

Lighting must be soft, luminous, and cinematic. Use warm golden highlights indoors, beautiful natural sunlight outdoors, shallow depth of field for beauty close-ups, delicate atmospheric haze, realistic reflections, and subtle rainbow refractions.

The world must feel extravagant, romantic, magical, and photorealistic rather than cartoonish.

2. MASTER CHARACTER BIBLE AND IDENTITY LOCK

Use the uploaded photographs of the real woman as the primary identity reference. Use the approved Character Bible as a supplementary visual guide.

Preserve her recognizable facial identity throughout the film, including facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, cheeks, skin tone, distinctive beauty marks, age appearance, and natural body proportions.

The character must remain the same woman in every scene.

Her transformation styling consists of:

Beauty ritual: A glossy blush-pink satin robe with ivory lace cuffs over a cream slip, pink hair rollers, elegant earrings, and soft, polished makeup.

Finished princess look: Long, voluminous honey-blonde waves, refined soft-glam makeup, deep pink lipstick, matching crystal earrings, and an extravagant blush-pink off-the-shoulder ball gown.

The gown features a crystal-encrusted bodice, sparkling sequins, floral appliqués, layered ruffles, and a dramatic, flowing train.

Maintain the same gown design, hairstyle, makeup, jewellery, and proportions throughout the princess scenes.

No glasses. No head tie. No face replacement. No unnecessary facial reshaping, skin-tone changes, age changes, or identity drift.

The hair transformation must progress naturally from the rollers to the finished waves. Once the finished hairstyle appears, maintain it consistently.

3. MASTER CAMERA BIBLE

Use smooth, deliberate, cinematic camera movements.

Employ slow dolly-ins for intimate beauty moments, medium close-ups for grooming actions, over-the-shoulder framing for mirror scenes, smooth tracking shots for walking, close-up detail shots for the gown, slightly low angles for the royal reveal, and wide establishing shots for the palace and garden.

Use controlled pans, gentle camera arcs, and slow pullbacks. Keep the woman recognizable whenever her face is visible.

All movements must feel physically believable. Hair, satin, lace, and the ball gown must respond naturally to motion and gravity.

Avoid abrupt zooms, random rotations, excessive camera shake, distorted motion, and unnecessary transitions.

Preserve the composition of each supplied reference image wherever possible.

4. EIGHT-SCENE VIDEO SEQUENCE

Generate each scene as a separate image-to-video clip, using its corresponding reference frame as the starting image.

FRAME 1 — THE BEAUTY RITUAL

Duration: 4 seconds

The woman sits at an ornate gold vanity inside the pink rococo boudoir, wearing her satin robe and cream slip, with pink hair rollers arranged in her hair.

She gently adjusts one roller and looks into the antique oval mirror with a soft, confident smile.

The camera slowly pushes in from a medium shot toward her face. Crystal lights sparkle softly in the background, candles flicker naturally, and the room glows with warm rose-gold illumination.

Preserve her facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, and the established environment.
Transition: A gentle cinematic cut into the next beauty shot.

FRAME 2 — THE HAIR REVEAL

Duration: 4 seconds

Continue in the same boudoir, with identical clothing, earrings, vanity, lighting, and background.

The woman carefully removes the remaining pink hair rollers and gently brushes her long honey-blonde hair. The waves fall naturally around her shoulders.

Use a medium close-up with a slow side-tracking movement. Her hands move naturally, and her hair responds realistically to the brush.

Keep her face consistent with the identity reference.
Transition: A match cut following the movement of the hairbrush.

FRAME 3 — THE FINAL BEAUTY TOUCH

Duration: 4 seconds

The woman sits before the antique oval mirror and applies deep pink lipstick using an elegant gold lipstick tube.

Her makeup is refined, her lashes are defined, and her skin retains realistic texture. She looks into her reflection with a composed, pleased expression.

Begin with a close-up of the lipstick application, then gently shift focus toward her eyes and mirror reflection.

Crystal perfume bottles, roses, and warm golden highlights remain visible around the vanity.
Transition: A soft match cut from the gold vanity details to the gilded wardrobe.

FRAME 4 — THE WARDROBE OPENS

Duration: 4 seconds

The woman rises from the vanity and walks gracefully across the marble floor toward the towering cream-and-gold wardrobe.

Her blush-pink satin robe moves naturally as she walks.

She places her hand on the ornate wardrobe door and slowly opens it, revealing a magnificent blush-pink ball gown displayed against a pink tufted velvet interior.

Use a smooth tracking shot from behind and slightly to the side, followed by a gentle pan revealing the gown.
Keep the wardrobe architecture, lighting, and gown design consistent with the Visual Bible.

Transition: Cut toward the gown as its crystals catch the light.

FRAME 5 — THE GOWN REVEAL

Duration: 4 seconds

The woman stands beside the displayed ball gown, gently touching its embellished bodice and layered ruffles.

The gown has an off-the-shoulder silhouette, intricate floral appliqués, sparkling sequins, crystal embellishments, and a voluminous blush-pink skirt.

Start with a detailed close-up of the crystal bodice, glide slowly across the floral embellishments and ruffles, then return to a medium shot of the woman admiring the dress.

The crystals should sparkle naturally without excessive flashing. Preserve the gown's design and the woman's facial identity.
Transition: A brief, elegant magical shimmer introduces the completed transformation.

FRAME 6 — THE PRINCESS TRANSFORMATION

Duration: 5 seconds

Reveal the woman now wearing the complete blush-pink crystal ball gown.

Her long honey-blonde waves frame her face. She wears matching crystal earrings and elegant soft-glam makeup.

She takes a graceful step forward, gently lifts a small section of her skirt, and turns slightly to reveal the full silhouette and volume of the gown.

Begin at a slightly low angle, then move smoothly backward to reveal her full figure, the grand staircase, crystal chandeliers, gilded architectural details, and polished marble floors.
The transformation must feel magical, seamless, and elegant.

Maintain her facial identity, natural proportions, hairstyle, jewellery, and exact gown design.

Transition: Follow her movement toward the tall French doors.

FRAME 7 — THE ENCHANTED GARDEN

Duration: 5 seconds

The woman walks through the open French doors into the sunlit enchanted garden.

Her magnificent pink gown trails behind her across the marble terrace. Rose petals drift gently through the air.

She walks toward the flower-covered arches and turns gracefully over her shoulder to look back at the camera.

Use a smooth rear three-quarter tracking shot, followed by a gentle side arc.
Reveal cascading pink roses, blue hydrangeas, lavender wisteria, white marble columns, flower-covered arches, and the turquoise reflecting pool.

The garden must feel like a natural continuation of the same royal estate.

Use luminous natural sunlight, realistic reflections, gentle floral movement, and a dreamy cinematic atmosphere.

Transition: A slow, graceful camera move toward the crystal swing.

FRAME 8 — THE CRYSTAL SWING FINALE

Duration: 6 seconds

The woman sits gracefully on an elaborate crystal-and-flower swing beside the turquoise reflecting pool.

Her voluminous pink ball gown spreads naturally across the seat and cascades toward the marble edge.

She gently sways, rests one hand on the flower-covered swing chain, and allows one foot to touch the water, creating delicate concentric ripples.

She looks upward briefly and then smiles peacefully.
Hanging crystals catch the sunlight, creating subtle rainbow refractions. Pink petals float across the water, and the surrounding flowers sway gently in the breeze.

Begin with a medium shot of the woman on the swing, then slowly pull back to reveal the magnificent garden, palace columns, flowers, turquoise pool, and sparkling crystal details.

End on a stable, beautiful wide shot with the woman clearly recognizable.

5. FAIRY-TALE MUSIC AND SOUND DESIGN

Generate a continuous, enchanting orchestral fairy-tale soundtrack that complements the complete transformation.

The music should feel magical, romantic, elegant, luxurious, emotionally uplifting, and cinematic.

Use delicate celesta, sparkling music-box notes, soft piano, graceful strings, gentle harp arpeggios, shimmering bells, and subtle orchestral swells.

Frame 1 — Beauty ritual: Delicate music-box notes, soft harp, and gentle piano establish a dreamy, intimate mood.

Frame 2 — Hair reveal: Introduce flowing strings and delicate chimes as the hair is released and brushed.

Frame 3 — Final beauty touch: Use graceful piano and sparkling high notes to accompany the lipstick application and mirror reflection.

Frame 4 — Wardrobe opening: Build anticipation with rising strings, subtle orchestral swells, and a gentle magical shimmer.

Frame 5 — Gown reveal: Introduce a beautiful musical swell, harp glissandos, sparkling bells, and rich strings as the gown is revealed.

Frame 6 — Princess transformation: Deliver the musical highlight with an uplifting orchestral flourish, shimmering chimes, and majestic strings as the woman appears in her complete gown.

Frame 7 — Enchanted garden: Open into a sweeping, romantic orchestral melody with graceful strings, harp, and gentle outdoor ambience.

Frame 8 — Crystal swing finale: Resolve into a peaceful, magical ending with delicate piano, celestial chimes, warm strings, and a gentle final musical flourish.

Environmental sound effects

Add subtle, realistic sound effects synchronized with the visible actions:

Soft satin rustling and gentle hair brushing.

A delicate lipstick cap click.

The wardrobe doors opening.

Light crystal chimes during the gown reveal.

Graceful footsteps on marble.

A gentle garden breeze and distant birdsong.
Soft rustling petals and floral movement.
Gentle water ripples when her foot touches the pool.
Keep the music smooth and continuous across all eight shots. Balance environmental sounds beneath the soundtrack. Let the music rise during the gown reveal and princess transformation, then soften during the finale.
No dialogue, narration, or vocals. No abrupt audio cuts, distorted sound, or sudden volume changes.
If native audio generation is unavailable, add one continuous fairy-tale soundtrack and synchronized sound effects during editing.
6. MOTION AND QUALITY CONTROL
Maintain realistic anatomy, natural blinking, subtle breathing, graceful posture, and believable hand movements.

Ensure the woman's face remains recognizable and stable throughout each shot.

The gown must retain its design, colour, crystal embellishments, floral appliqués, and voluminous shape.

Hair must flow naturally. Fabric must respond realistically to walking, turning, and sitting. Water must ripple naturally when touched.

Keep the lighting, visual palette, and architectural details consistent with the supplied reference images.

Avoid facial morphing, distorted hands, extra fingers, duplicated jewellery, flickering crystals, melting fabric, sudden wardrobe changes, unnatural walking, cartoon effects, excessive motion blur, and random scene changes.

Do not introduce extra characters, unplanned props, captions, logos, or watermarks.

7. FINAL ASSEMBLY

Generate all eight shots separately and arrange them in chronological order.

Use the corresponding reference image for each shot and the same character-reference settings wherever supported.

Use smooth match cuts, gentle dissolves, and restrained magical transitions. Maintain a consistent cinematic colour grade across the full film.

Add the fairy-tale soundtrack across the complete edit, with synchronized sound effects at the appropriate moments.

FINAL RESULT: A breathtaking, photorealistic princess transformation film that begins with an intimate beauty ritual, builds through the royal gown reveal, and concludes with a magical crystal-swing scene in an enchanted palace garden.

MODULE::PRODUCT{name:AI-Portrait-Retouch, ver:1.0.0, spec:iLang-v5.0}

::GENE{ T: transform casual selfie into studio-grade art portrait T: user provides one photo, AI delivers finished portrait T: face identity preserved — output is recognizably the same person T: multiple style presets available — user picks aesthetic direction A: alter face identity beyond recognition A: use celebrity face as style source A: output resolution below 1024×1024 }
::STATE{ input:   one clear-face photo (selfie, ID photo, any casual shot) output:  art portrait PNG, magazine-grade, 1024×1024 method:  ComfyUI + PuLID-Flux + FLUX-REDUX runtime: ~40 seconds per image on RTX 4090 }
§1 WHAT THIS DOES
One photo in. One art portrait out. No Photoshop. No photography skill. AI handles lighting, composition, and style transfer while keeping your face.
Original post reference: @aipgh6 — casual selfie → dark editorial magazine portrait in one pass.
§2 TOOL SETUP
2.1 Environment
Pick ONE:
OPTION HOW     Cloud GPU (fastest start) https://t.co/yA2oliGyVM → rent RTX 4090 instance → select ComfyUI pre-built image   Local GPU NVIDIA RTX 3060+ with 8GB+ VRAM, CUDA installed   Mac M2 Pro+ 16GB unified memory (slower, ~3min/image)

2.2 Install ComfyUI
git clone https://t.co/W3xVAOKRIm
cd ComfyUI
pip install -r requirements.txt
2.3 Install Plugins
cd custom_nodes
git clone https://t.co/nSDqnDZNpQ
pip install insightface onnxruntime-gpu
2.4 Download Models
FILE PUT IN SIZE     pulid_flux_v0.9.1.safetensors models/pulid/ ~1GB   flux1-redux-dev.safetensors models/style_models/ ~300MB   flux1-dev.safetensors models/unet/ ~12GB   clip_l.safetensors models/clip/ ~250MB   t5xxl_fp16.safetensors models/clip/ ~9GB   ae.safetensors models/vae/ ~300MB

All from HuggingFace. Search model name → download safetensors file → drop into folder.

§3 EXECUTION — ONE PHOTO TO PORTRAIT

Step 1: Prepare

Launch ComfyUI: python https://t.co/SHwmOof8Nt → open browser at localhost:8188

Have ready: your photo (clear face, front-facing) + one style reference image

Step 2: Build Workflow (node chain)

LoadImage(YOUR_PHOTO)
  → ImageCropFace(method=InsightFace)
  → PulidFluxModelLoader(pulid_flux_v0.9.1)
  → ApplyPulidFlux(weight=0.85)
  ↘
    LoadImage(STYLE_REFERENCE)
    → CLIPVisionEncode
    → StyleModelApply(model=flux1-redux-dev, weight=0.70)
    ↘
      CLIPTextEncode(prompt — see below)
      → KSamplerSelect(sampler=euler, steps=25, cfg=3.5)
      → VAEDecode
      → SaveImage(format=PNG)

Step 3: Set Prompt
Text prompt in CLIPTextEncode node:
professional portrait photograph, dramatic studio lighting,
sharp focus, shallow depth of field, high detail,
elegant composition, 8k quality
Adjust per desired style:
Cool/Editorial: add dark background, moody shadows, fashion magazine
Clean/Natural: add soft natural light, minimal background, fresh
Cinematic: add film grain, warm color grade, anamorphic
B&W Classic: add black and white, high contrast, timeless
Step 4: Key Parameters
PARAMETER VALUE WHY     PuLID weight 0.85 face stays recognizable while allowing artistic transformation   REDUX weight 0.70 strong style transfer without overriding face structure   Steps 25 quality-speed sweet spot   CFG 3.5 FLUX works best at low CFG   Resolution 1024×1024 native FLUX resolution   Sampler euler fastest stable sampler for FLUX
Step 5: Generate and Check

Click Queue Prompt. Wait ~40 seconds.

Check output:
Face looks like you? → ✓
Style matches reference? → ✓
No artifacts (extra fingers, distorted features)? → ✓
If face drifted: raise PuLID weight to 0.90

If style too weak: raise REDUX weight to 0.80

If artifacts: regenerate with different seed
§4 STYLE REFERENCE — WHERE TO GET THEM
You need ONE style reference image per generation. This image defines the artistic look (lighting, color, mood). Your face replaces the face in the output.
Sources for style reference images:
Pinterest: search "editorial portrait photography" / "studio portrait dark"

Unsplash: search "portrait" filtered by mood
Midjourney showcase: grab any art portrait you like the style of
Save 5-10 references you like. Each one = a different output style from the same selfie.
§5 ACCEPTANCE CHECKS
# CHECK EXPECTED     1 ComfyUI running localhost:8188 accessible   2 All models loaded no missing-model errors in console   3 Face detected InsightFace finds bounding box in your photo   4 Output generated PNG saved, 1024×1024   5 Face preserved output face recognizably = input face   6 Style applied output aesthetic matches style reference   7 Artifact-free no distorted features, no extra limbs
::JUDGE{ scope: pure execution — one photo in, one art portrait out verdict: EXECUTABLE constraint: requires NVIDIA GPU (cloud or local) for ComfyUI + FLUX pipeline alternative: if no GPU access, use https://t.co/MnhWC9wFC9 (cloud API, pay per image, no setup) }

Multi-objective protein optimization via modular diffusion steering

1 MODS is a modular framework that turns multi-objective protein design into inference-time steering of a fixed pretrained diffusion model, aiming to recover diverse Pareto tradeoffs under tight experimental-style budgets (few batched rounds).

2 Key idea: for each candidate proposal, MODS samples (a) augmented Chebyshev scalarization weights and (b) one member from a surrogate ensemble, combining them into a single scalar reward used for steering. Weight sampling explores different objective preferences; ensemble-member sampling explores predictive uncertainty.

3 The scalarization uses an augmented Chebyshev form: it emphasizes improving the worst-performing (weighted) objective while still rewarding progress on the others, helping recover tradeoffs on non-convex Pareto fronts where simple weighted sums can fail.

4 MODS separates “what to optimize” (multi-objective acquisition via scalar rewards) from “how to generate” (diffusion model + steering method). This makes the approach plug-and-play with different diffusion priors and compatible steering procedures.

5 Optimization loop: start with an initial evaluated set (100 sequences), then iterate 8 rounds of batched acquisition (100 sequences/round). After each round, MODS retrains only the fitness surrogate ensemble on accumulated observations, and reuses the same pretrained diffusion generator (no generator fine-tuning).

6 Implementations tested: two diffusion priors (MDLM masked diffusion LM; D3PM discrete diffusion) and two steering procedures (Classifier Guidance, CG; Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling, DAPS). Main comparisons focus on DAPS because it performed best across tasks.

7 Evaluation spans six assay-derived oracle benchmarks (5 two-objective tasks: GB1, ERBIN-PDZ1, NHERF3-PDZ2, KRAS, Src; 1 three-objective task: NHERF3-PDZ1). Oracles are CNN ensembles trained on experimental assay datasets with a distance-based penalty to discourage overconfident extrapolation far from labeled mutational neighborhoods.

8 Results: across all tasks, MODS improves substantially over unsteered sampling from the same diffusion model, and is competitive or best versus iterative baselines (ARLM+DPO, LaMBO-2, SAGE-Prot). In Table 1, MODS achieves the top mean final hypervolume on 5/6 tasks with D3PM+DAPS, and is close to the best baseline on Src with MDLM+DAPS.

9 Practical insight: steering strength matters. Too-weak regularization (oversteering away from the diffusion prior) can hurt on some tasks, consistent with reliance on less reliable surrogate predictions; the optimal setting depends jointly on task, diffusion prior, and steering procedure.
